commits.message: Fixed apparent copy/paste error in cron debug output
Minor lua cleanup
Split lua module into more files.
Added half-baked at/cron functions.
Fix broken builtins.
Added help, youtubemeta and lua to default modules.

New module! Lua module lets users write their own module.

Currently very incomplete but vaguely usable.
Features a web interface for creating/editing modules.
Event system that fires on received command
Sandboxed execution with guards against infinite loops, etc.
Assorted functions to interact with the world.

Needs significant work and cleanup.

Changes to webserver for increased flexibility

- Added postdata parsing
- Added ability for handler to deal with entire process itself.
Webserver module now quits more reliably.

Changes to improve behaviour when attached to a Skype bridge.

- Request full names via WHOIS if on Skype network.
Fixed typo in USER command that broke some servers.
Fixed display error in AI module commands.
Fixed error in datastore preventing storage of boolean False.
Added the ability to specify origin and target languages for !translate
Fixed missing leading zero on single-digit seconds in youtubemeta.

Added youtubemeta module - thanks Davy :D
- Displays metadata when a YouTube video mentioned.
Added webpage for help (currently rather rudimentary)
Fixed error in help entry for RSS module's subscribe command.
Added !fortune command to supposedlyfunny.
Added special case to chantrack for mibbit users so we get their real hostname instead.
Renamed "time" to "traveltime" in maps module.
Moved "uptime" from reference to meta.
Added "help" module with help for all known commands.
Added meta module with sourcestats command.

Very old changes:
- Support passwords when connecting to networks
- Check cron jobs every second
- Don't do syntax highlighting in dynamic
- Don't set modes if there are none to set.

More secondlife stuff.
- Improved "sensor"
- Added "slstats"
- Random fiddling elsewhere.
Actually included KathBot3.lsl

Added a secondlife module
Also poked at the webserver's handling of query strings.
Fix "revert" with NULL creator.

More playing with dynamic module
- Added "revert" command
- Added more detail to revisions command
- Fixed webpage list (removed duplicates, alphabetical sorting)

Added versioning to dynamic commands
- Added new "revisions" command
- Added optional revision argument to "source" command

Added stuff to autoload.
Added [localhttp] tag.
Spore module handles updates to old assets differently
Added all the various missing tables.

Spore module can now provide notifications
- Added sporespam to spore module to control notifications per channel
- Added myspore command to opt-in to notifications
- Improved serialising in the datastore module
- Enabled deletion of settings in the datastore module
- Chantrack module can now return all channels a UID is in (and their nick)
- Added functions to get aliases by nick and get nick by ID to the security module
- Various improvements to Maxis' Spore API.
You can now store arbitrary datatypes in the datastore.
Added "spore" module (with one command so far)

Better handling of multi-file modules
- Modules may be a folder with the module in __init__.py
- Any other Python files in that folder will automatically be imported for the module

- Also fixed chantrack bug if KathBot has any channel modes other than +o or +v.
Because git is a complete pain in the ass.
Merge branch 'davy/master'

Added global settings to datastore
- Also refectored some code into a KBDict base class to save on repetition

Improvements to dynamic parser
- Added [switch] and [case] tags, and let the self-closing [|] be used in place of [case]
- Added Python-style [substr] tag.
- [regex] tag now accepts a variable for the expression
- Added get_var_maybe function to clean up some code.
- Other stuff.

Minor changes
- Updated URL in response to CTCP SOURCE command
- Added "uptime" command to reference module.

Random improvements
- AI: save data every 10 minutes, tweak popular word limit
- Dynamic: changed how [math] is broken.
Fix stupid find/replace bug in chantrack

Improvements to inventory module
- Interactions work
- Removed "[Inventory]" from output
- Changed formatting
- Changed adding from (..) to {..}
- Fixed give_stat, add_item, add_effect, add_stat
- Moved repetitive code into create_user_maybe
- Improve inventory listing format

Fixed chantrack hostname bugs
- USERHOST requests are batched in fives
- Also made its debug spam use logger.debug instead of logger.info

Improvements to AI module
- Ignore most popular words
- Fix repeated words
- Can set response frequency and learning from IRC
- More stats
- Changed logging
- Other fun stuff.
Added get() method to new datastore stuff.
Merge branch 'newdatastore'
Merge branch 'master' of git://github.com/Davymaltz/KathBot3 into davy/master

Added [unhtml] tag, removed foon command
(Foon can now be a dynamic command.)
"in" keyword works on the datastore stuff.

Added some helpers to datastore
Modules can now do m('datastore').users[uid][setting] to reference a setting for a user
Modules can do m('datastore').channels[(network, channel)][setting] for a setting for a channel.
Merge branch 'master' of git://github.com/Davymaltz/KathBot3 into davy/master
Added verb stats.
Fixed random typo.
Added AI module (output currently disabled)
Enabled hook threading again.
Fixed import error in dynamic module
Merge branch 'master' of git@github.com:Katharine/KathBot3

Pisg will use data from unregistered users
Also made it refuse to run more than once simultaneously on a given channel.
Webserver can handle unicode in static files

Pisg module now handles genders
- Added "gender" command
- Writes genders to alias file
Any module can now create new dynamic tags.

Dynamic: support functions in if/while/math/etc.
- TagContext inherits from dict
  - Runs any defined functions if accessed
- get_var uses TagContext access when no attribute supplied
- all eval() functions now receive context in place of context.variables
Dynamic: moved all tags into tag_* functions

Started refactoring dynamic module
- Pass around TagContext object instead of many variables
- Call functions (which aren't written yet)

Moved pisg stats to webserver hosting
- Copied over the required pisg files.
Added get_root_address() to webserver
Added logging messages to nick stuff

Improved nick handling.
- The whole nick list is now tried before giving up and disconnecting
- The bot can be renamed.
Fixed "append" confirmation in dynamic.
Pisg module uses aliases from security module.

Core load/unload commands merged
Also minor changes to the module handler
Added todo to autoload sequence.

Added places to dynamic
Added level command to security
Fixed addalias command in security
Changed behaviour of [import] in dynamic
Allow variables in [random] in dynamic
Escape HTML in quotes webpages.
Fixed infinite loop in dynamic module's word_from_file function.

Dynamic module:
- Moved [args] variable into [args] tag, supports [args num] and [args start:finish] formats.
- Added support for functions (defined using the [func] tag)
- eval handles newlines and parse errors correctly
- [choose] can now use [|] in all cases
- Probably other stuff.

Added [import], [include] tags to dynamic parser, plus [indef] shortcut.
Fixed bug in dynamic [indefinite] and capital letters
Return inserted quote number in quotes module
Added whattodo command to todo module.
Fixed story files with spaces in zmachine
Fixed bug in rss module's subscribe command preventing subscribing
Changed network.py config file to an example.
Fix bug in chanmanage, fix bug in dynamic's source command.

Fixed potential deadlock in logger module
Fixed zmachine saves breaking
Added mode tracking to chantrack
Added the ability to use KathBot in a private message.
Added new "message" hook, called by irc_helpers, and changed all modules to use it.

Don't crash the network thread on invalid unicode(!)
Fixed bug in chantrack (thanks, Selig!)

Added years/months to dynamic [countup/down]
Reverted zmachine to working version

Decode incoming messages immediately
chantrack tracks hosts and idents
security's access command can take an argument

All hooks now run in their own thread
Moved encoding comment to correct location in irc_helpers
Core module no longer crashes when irc_helpers is unavailable

Use own quote function in reference module to avoid multibyte unicode issues with urllib's
Added referrer to reference module

Sets numeric locale on startup
Fixed bug in IRC manager where failure to send a message would deadlock the network thread
Added reference module (google and wikipedia commands)
Added supposedlyfunny module (bash and fml commands)
Added datastoreirc module (dbhits command)
Fixed bug in chanmanage mute command
Fixed error in chantrack kick debug logging
Added html_to_irc convertor to irc_helpers
irc_helpers.parse now accepts multi-line input and preserves formatting over multiple lines
Changed rss to use new html_to_irc convertor and accept multiple lines.

Added sample data for driving module (real data is copyrighted)
Added official explanations to driving module
Added "modules" command to core module
Fixed cron support in cron module
Changed rss module to use a cronjob instead of its own FeedPoll thread.

Added cron module, providing `at` and `cron` functionality
Added "mute" command to chanmanage (disabled automodes for a given user for a set time)
chantrack now raises "joined" and "parted" events whenever KathBot joins or parts a channel
"loaded" and "unloaded" events are raised whenever a module is loaded/unloaded
Changed all threads (except core IRC threads) to run as daemon threads; this should fix shutdown hanging.
Fixed bug in core IRC code where all networks shared a write lock; now each network has its own write lock, as intended.
Added driving theory test module (yes, really).

chanmanage: Added the ability to automatically op/whatever people
security: Added the ability to set command access levels and add users
irclogger: Added support for multi-line errors
dynamic: Added webpage listing commands; added e, ln, log, log10, asin, acos, and atan functions to [math].
webserver: Added to module loading sequence
lastfm: Disabled impersonation, enabled channel spamming
